BrochureContent.Content:
Sheehy Meares Team Earley are delighted to present this traditional farmhouse on approx. 1.40 Acres located atLismurtagh, Tulsk, Castlerea, Co. Roscommon, F45 XC64

Sheehy Meares Team Earley are pleased to present this charming 3/4-bedroom traditional farmhouse situated on approximately 1.40 acres in a peaceful countryside setting.

The property offers bright and spacious accommodation, comprising a comfortable living room, a modern fitted kitchen, three/four bedrooms, and a stylish family bathroom. A second bathroom is currently nearing completion. The home has been recently rewired and replumbed, providing modern convenience and peace of mind for prospective purchasers.

A number of outbuildings are located adjacent to the residence, offering excellent storage space and potential for a variety of uses, subject to the necessary consents.

Additional features include oil-fired central heating, mains water connection, and broadband availability in the area. Some minor external finishing works remain to be completed.
This property presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-maintained country home with generous outdoor space and further potential in a tranquil rural location.
